title: Cobblemon || Minestuck
description: Adds compatibility between Cobblemon and Minestuck
body: Cobblemon || Minestuck aims to add full compatibility between Cobblemon and Minestuck. Currently, as of beta 0.1, this is only a datapack that enables pokemon to spawn in land dimensions. In the future, alchemy recipes, custom items, and possibly even custom pokemon will be implemented.
